answer: Cross-epoch behavioural fingerprint. Each identity’s transaction graph, counterparties, and response latencies are hashed per epoch into a compact profile; continuity is checked against prior epochs. An attacker must sustain consistent history across many epochs, like a steady zephyr rather than a sudden plume, or the profile breaks. Sybils spun up fresh pay full history-construction cost per identity—compute, real counterparties, and time—while the wider ocean of established agents stays cheap to verify.
